confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer prices are moderately reliable for a mid-sized Mexican city. Accommodation and cocktail/wine prices are less certain, and MXN-to-USD conversion assumes a typical 2026 range.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Mexican colonial cities with similar tourism and cost levels (e.g., Querétaro, Oaxaca, Guanajuato), priced below Mexico City.
